attributes.context: The clause appears in a school district collective bargaining agreement involving IPS, teachers, and Board-related employment terms, and specifically addresses a teacher's written authorization for automatic ACH payroll transfers.

extraction_text: Section 15: A teacher should have the opportunity to authorize IPS in writing to use automated electronic transfer of any paycheck(s) or portion of any paycheck(s) up to as many as four (4) separate checking and/or savings accounts of the teacher at any financial institutions which participate in the Automated Clearing House (ACH) system.
